title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows, optimize cache & hygiene
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Consolidates lint/test/release GitHub Actions into a single maintainable matrix; improves build cache hit rates; bumps several actions to supported versions; removes deprecated job duplication. No user-facing changes.
description:
Motivation: We have long-running and duplicated CI workflows across the monorepo (lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml plus per-repo overrides). This causes maintenance burden, inconsistent caching, and CI runtime variance. This PR implements a unified .github/workflows/ci.yml matrix that covers lint, unit/integration tests, and release automation staging jobs while improving cache usage and action hygiene.

What changed (high level):
- Add consolidated CI matrix '.github/workflows/ci.yml' with job matrix for node versions, OSes, and job types (lint/unit/integration/release-staging).
- Remove legacy workflows: .github/workflows/lint.yml, test.yml, release.yml (deleted).
- Update reusable workflow snippets in .github/workflows/actions/ to use pinned action versions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4).
- Introduce centralized cache key strategy: cache-node-modules + build-cache with workspace-aware prefixes to increase cache hit rate across packages.
- Add lightweight 'scripts/ci/cache-hygiene.sh' script to prune stale caches in long-running branches (invoked nightly via workflow).
- Bump GH Actions versions and replace deprecated actions (uses official setup-node and cache actions).

Checklist: 
- [x] Unify workflows into single CI matrix
- [x] Bump/replace deprecated actions
- [x] Validate lint + unit + integration runs across matrix
- [x] Add cache hygiene script and nightly job
- [x] Update team docs with new workflow usage

Testing & validation:
- Ran matrix locally using act for representative jobs (linux/node18 and macos/node18).
- CI run on this PR (see checks) completed with a single unit test rerun due to a known flaky test (ENG-4720) which was later muted in a separate flake-fix PR.

Linear references: ENG-4521 (CI unification), ENG-4720 (flake mitigation follow-up).

Notes on release automation: The release job is now a gated 'release-staging' job in the matrix that is triggered only on release branches via path filters; the final publish step still requires repository write perms and the existing release bot token. No change to published artifacts or versioning semantics.

Rollout plan: Merge to main, monitor CI time and cache hit metrics for 48h, revert to per-workflow split only if we observe >15% regression in median job time or increased flakes.
